item.text: {"source_id":"train-121-1","response_sha256":"eb31959bc206149a20218549825a2abb2208c2a55a5e56ec8d764015e295df8b","status":"supported_error","reference_review_needed":false,"evidence_quote":"Number of blocks in the remaining time: 4 hours * 2000 blocks per hour = 8000 blocks","evidence_start":null,"evidence_end":null,"evidence_occurrence":1,"question_evidence_quote":"They work for four hours and are then joined by 6 other people who also work at the same rate.","observed_error":"The response assigns four hours to the remaining work without support.","violated_condition":"The four hours precede the arrival of the six additional workers; the remaining duration is determined by the unfilled capacity divided by the eight-person rate.","error_description":"The response uses four hours as the duration after the six additional workers arrive, although the stated four hours apply only before their arrival. The remaining duration must depend on the 6000-block capacity minus the 2000 blocks already loaded, at 2000 blocks per hour. The written multiplication itself is correct.","reference_review_reason":null,"secondary_errors":["The response later treats the 6000-block capacity as a rate of 6000 blocks per hour and divides a block total by it to calculate total time."],"uncertainty_note":null}
